basic_info.description: Spectacular, showcase corner apartment at 1200 California featuring two walls of glass to admire the Golden Gate and seascape beyond.  A masterful transformation under the guidance of Imbue Design and Baxter Construction, this home is like no other on Nob Hill. Rift-sawn, white oak floors are highlighted by custom wood precision louvers and pocket doors that slide open and close to define spaces. Bespoke custom light fixtures complement recessed lighting throughout. Chef's open layout kitchen features a breakfast bar and quartz counters/backsplash amidst topline appliances. Waterworks & other leading brands define elegant, spacious, & contemporary bathrooms. Smart home features include personal-device control of lighting, Lutron shades, and entertainment systems. Providing the ultimate in City location near favorite restaurants and supermarkets, Mid-Century Modern 1200 California thrives amid the vibrancy of Nob Hill and includes the services of a 24/7 door-staff & attended lobby, on-site residential manager, maintenance and engineering staffs, garage parking for one car, storage locker, and a ﬁtness center.
